Description: IP address players use to reach this server. It is written as the node address in cloud/data/cloud.xml, which the load balancer hands to clients for the shard, chat and battle servers. Empty = use the application IP binding, or if that is 0.0.0.0 the instance IP binding (Webserver.IPBinding), or 127.0.0.1 if neither is set. Must be an IP of one of the host's own network interfaces (for example a NetBird/Tailscale/LAN IP): Hub finds its own node by checking its interfaces, so a DNS name or NAT-forwarded public IP stops Hub from starting. Set 127.0.0.1 for the game's original same-machine-only value. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/cloud.xml (Node address), star-conflict/server/cloud/data/loadbalancer_local.cfg, star-conflict/server/cloud/data/shard_local.cfg.

Credits a newly created account starts with (credits_on_start, vanilla 0). Only affects accounts created after the change. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Maximum number of players online at once. This is AMP's own player limit (shown in the user count), and it is written to the load balancer's per-shard limit lb_limitPlayersOnShardTo (vanilla 800). The server has a single shard, so this is the server-wide limit. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Gives every player account permanent premium by adding the default 'player' role to auth_infinitePremiumForRoles (vanilla "gm;support"). Applies to existing and new accounts; untick and restart to revert. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Extra credits from the new-account starter pack (starter_pack.xml 'credits'), on top of Starting Credits. Only affects accounts created after the change. Default 0. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/starter_pack.xml.

Extra Galactic Standards from the new-account starter pack (starter_pack.xml 'goldCredits'), on top of Starting Galactic Standards. Only affects accounts created after the change. Default 0. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/starter_pack.xml.

Token credits in the new-account starter pack (starter_pack.xml 'tokenCredits'), the daily-limited currency (sv_tokenCreditsDailyLimit). Only affects accounts created after the change. Default 0. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/starter_pack.xml.

Galactic Standards given to every player on the winning team of a battle (reward_bonusGoldForWinner, vanilla 0). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Galactic Standards given to every player on the losing team of a battle (reward_bonusGoldForLooser, vanilla 0). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Total number of ships in an arena (PvP) match; bots fill up to this number. Seen on this server: 6 gave the player plus 5 bots (3v3). Each queue caps it at its own size: the newbie arena queue (low matchmaking rating) holds 16 (8v8), the regular arena queues 24 (12v12). Written to cvars.mm_botsCount and to botsCount in both arena queue templates' special table. Vanilla 6. SCPatcher also turns Kick Excessive Bots off for this. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (cvars.mm_botsCount line and the two arena 'special = { arcade = 1 }' lines, edited in place).

cvars.sv_kickExcessiveBotsEnabled (vanilla On). The game's own comment: kick from the battle when there are more bots than players; the battle server removes such a bot with a special 'kick excessive bot' damage. Most likely this makes room when real players join a running match, but that is not documented. SCPatcher turns it off for full bot matches. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (cvars.sv_kickExcessiveBotsEnabled line, edited in place).

Makes every item ever sold purchasable, including obsolete and dev test items (cvars.store_allowAllItemsForBying). Buying the wrong thing can break an account. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (cvars.store_allowAllItemsForBying line, edited in place).

Galactic Standards (premium currency) a newly created account starts with (gold_on_start, vanilla 300). Only affects accounts created after the change. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Days of premium a newly created account starts with, on top of the couple of days every new account gets anyway (premium_on_start, vanilla 0). The game takes this value in hours and multiplies it by 3600 into a 32-bit number, so it is written as days x 24 and capped at 20000 days (about 54 years); larger values overflow (3650 days written as seconds once gave 16490 days). Only affects accounts created after the change. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).
Premium time granted for each account rank-up, in hours (premiumTimeForAccountRank, vanilla 24). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Multiplies the experience earned in battles (rate_exp) and in open space (sv_expRate) for every ship rank. 1 = vanilla. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).
Multiplies the credits earned in battles for every ship rank (rate_cred). 1 = vanilla. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

DisplayName: First Win Of The Day XP Multiplier
Description: XP multiplier for the first PvP, PvE, coop and brawl win of the day (sv_dailyWin*ExpRewardCf, vanilla 3). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).
Maximum token credits a player can earn per day (sv_tokenCreditsDailyLimit, vanilla 1000). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Multiplies every price of ships in the store: credits, GS, tokens and event price (store_vesselPriceMod, vanilla 1, range 0.001-100). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Multiplies every price of modules in the store (store_modulePriceMod, vanilla 1, range 0.001-100). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Multiplies every price of munitions in the store (store_munitionPriceMod, vanilla 1, range 0.001-100). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Seconds of inactivity before a player is kicked from a battle (sv_afkCheckDuration, vanilla 120). A large value such as 3600 effectively disables the AFK kick. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).
Credits it costs to resurrect in open space (sv_resurrectionCreditsPrice, vanilla 100000). Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (AMP block at the end of the file).

Runs the battle pass (one stage, the 41 rewards in battle_pass.xml) from Battle Pass Start until Battle Pass End. Untick and restart to restore the game's original, expired 2023 battle pass dates. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (battlePassStart / battlePassEndTable at the top and cvars.store_battlePassUnlockLvlBtnStart, edited in place).

Start of the battle pass, in UTC. Any common date format works, e.g. 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z or 10/13/2026 00:00:00 (month first); it is converted to the game's YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ, and the console shows the result. Player progress is stored per start time: changing it starts a new battle pass and existing progress is lost (DLC-bought premium is kept). Also when the 'unlock level' button appears. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (battlePassStart and cvars.store_battlePassUnlockLvlBtnStart, edited in place).

End of the battle pass, in UTC, in the same formats as Battle Pass Start. Empty = no end; it stays active until the battle pass is switched off. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (battlePassEndTable at the top, edited in place).

0 = vanilla: the enemy team is sized to the number of players, so a solo player gets a 1v1. N (2-6) fills a solo player's coop match to NvN with N-1 allied and N enemy bots (botsCount = 2N-1, botsInTeam1 = N-1 in the coop queues' special table); with more players their team grows by one per extra player. The newbie coop queue holds at most 8 ships (4v4), the regular coop queues 12 (6v6). Experimental: it is not confirmed that the matchmaker uses these values instead of recalculating them - check botsCount/botsInTeam1 in the battle log (cloud/Hub/logs/<date>/dediserver*.log in the Wine prefix) after a match. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua (the three 'coop_vs_ai = 1' special entries, edited in place).

Bundled: the MongoDB 2.6 that ships with the server, run under Wine, data in star-conflict/mongo-data. External: an existing MongoDB server set in External MongoDB Hosts; the bundled one is not started. The game's database driver has no login support, so the external MongoDB must accept connections without authentication from this host (keep it on a private network/firewalled), and it speaks the old wire protocol, so use MongoDB 4.4 or older (5.1+ dropped the legacy commands). Data is not migrated automatically: mongodump the cosmosim_<user>, stats_cosmosim_<user>, achievements_<user>, logs_<user>, games_<user> and delivered_<user> databases from the bundled one and mongorestore them into the external one first. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/common_local.cfg (AMP block, external only).

Only used with MongoDB set to External. Written to the game's db_mongoHosts: host:port, or a replica set as host1:port,host2:port,host3:port (the game finds the primary itself); options may follow after | (for example |connpool=5). Port defaults to 27017. The start waits up to 60 seconds for one of the hosts to accept connections. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/common_local.cfg (AMP block).

Where Update gets the server files from. Tarball URL: downloads and extracts the server tarball (cloud/, data/, sys_data/) from Server Tarball URL into star-conflict/server. SteamCMD: installs Steam app 212070 (Windows depot, about 12 GB) into star-conflict/212070 with AMP's SteamCMD and hard-links it into star-conflict/server (no extra disk space; the template's config edits replace files instead of changing them, so Steam's copies stay untouched). SteamCMD needs a Steam login: anonymous download is refused for this app ('No subscription'). AMP asks for the Steam username, password and Steam Guard code during the update. The account must have Star Conflict in its library (free to play: add it once in the Steam client); a separate Steam account just for the server is recommended. Files only present in star-conflict/server (such as common_local.cfg) are kept either way.

Direct download URL of the server tarball (.tar.gz with ./cloud, ./data and ./sys_data at the top level), used with Server Files Source = Tarball URL. Must be a direct link, not a share page; for a Nextcloud share use https://<host>/public.php/dav/files/<share token> or append /download. See the README for how to build the tarball.

Shows the 14 former DLC packs (Bundle_Arc_DLC_*: Soldier of Fortune, Galaxy Explorer, Elite Pilot, Corsair, Jolly Roger, Dead Man's Chest, the six Fleet Strength ships, Dogs of War, Object NY18) in the in-game shop, where they cost Galactic Standards (2100-20000 GS). The packs are hidden in the client's shop; this sets the store's IS_SHOW flag on them in store.xml (all four item flags, flags=15, since the bit values are not documented, so they may also get hot/new badges). Experimental: check the shop's bundle section after a restart. Off restores the original store.xml. Edits: star-conflict/server/cloud/data/store.xml (the 14 Bundle_Arc_DLC_* Item lines).
